notes: Event date: CMH The Last Offensive ch. 13 p. 292: "until midday 25 March, when General Kniess and the staff of his LXXXV Corps arrived"; "When General Kniess took over from the provisional XII Corps on 25 March, he inherited only one divisional unit, the weak, almost ineffectual 159th Infantry Division".
